title: The algebraic classification of five-dimensional nilpotent right alternative algebras
summary: We develop the method of central extensions (the Skjelbred--Sund method) for nilpotent right alternative algebras over the field of complex numbers and apply it to obtain the algebraic classification of five-dimensional nilpotent right alternative algebras. More precisely, we classify, up to isomorphism, all complex five-dimensional nilpotent right alternative algebras that have no annihilator component (that is, which are not a direct sum of a smaller algebra and a one-dimensional algebra with zero product) and which are not $2$-step nilpotent.
